changelog:
Ask about a meeting, and remove action items that don't apply to you.

Your phone can now ask a question about one meeting and get an answer from that meeting only. When the phone has your desktop, the desktop answers. If something wasn't discussed, it says so instead of guessing.

Action items you remove on your phone are removed here too, and they stay gone when the meeting syncs again.

Includes 0.1.71: closing the dashboard closes DensAssistant.
